verdict.rationale: Together AI documents a dynamic rate-limit system (adjusts per model based on live capacity and recent successful usage, rising with sustained traffic) and notes dedicated endpoints have no hard rate limits, giving developers some visibility before hitting limits. However, the evidence lacks concrete numeric tier tables (e.g., free vs paid vs enterprise thresholds) or a clear scaling schedule across usage tiers. Missing for 10: explicit per-tier numeric limits, documented upgrade path/thresholds, and independent confirmation that documented limits match real-world behavior.
